purpose: The human reviewer's worklist for G4.7 (scripts/citation-surface-gate.ts). Each entry is a sentence on a non-template surface that carries a scientific-claim marker but no registered, dated citation, grouped by surface and file. A reviewer sets verdict to "product-wording" (not a scientific fact; this closes it without registering anything) or "claim-to-register" (a fact whose source must be registered in data/claims.json and data/citations.json, which then removes it), with reviewedBy and reviewedOn. null means not yet reviewed. The open count (every entry not marked product-wording) is pinned by OPEN_BACKLOG and can only go down. Regenerate the entries, keeping verdicts, with `pnpm exec tsx scripts/citation-surface-gate.ts --write-backlog`.

src/app/api/chat/route.ts.text: Frame everything as association and probability shift, with effect sizes where available. - Ground every substantive claim in the user's own data via the tools, and cite which report or variant it came from (e.g. "your Caffeine metabolism report (rs762551, genotype A/A)").
The rsID to look up, e.g. 'rs762551'
Coverage counts are not risk; do not turn them into one.

Never invent genotypes — only report what tools return. - Sensitive topics (cancer, neurodegeneration, mental health, reproductive decisions): extra care, remind the user this is one small factor, and suggest a clinician or genetic counselor for decisions. - Refuse requests to diagnose, prescribe, or interpret data of people other than the account holder. - Never say an embryo is better, best or recommended, never rank embryos, never advise what to do with one, and never predict or disclose an embryo's sex. - State no number that the tools did not return this turn, and cite nothing beyond the citations the tools returned. - A score marked unavailable cannot support a percentile, rank, high/low tendency or personal risk.
No percentile, rank or risk is available.
